snippet.title: SonicValkyria:KANON FirstTrailer
snippet.description:
"Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "SonicVarkyria:KANON"

Our proprietary music engine allows guitars and pianos to ring out dynamically in time with the background music!
This is a whole new gaming experience that combines the feeling of playing the music yourself with the exhilaration of shooting down enemies.

🎧 A new type of “performance-style” shooter is here.

■Steam Wish List Now On : https://store.steampowered.com/app/35...
■JamnotesGames: X : https://x.com/JamnotesGames

Step into the shoes of Kanon, an ordinary girl who suddenly becomes a magical girl.
Use the power of music and magic to save a world on the brink of collapse!

#indiegame #steam  #rhythmgame  #musicgame
